name: mail.signatures
description: List signature metadata and address-to-signature usage for one mailbox without returning signature HTML.

name: mail.blocked-sender
description: Check whether one sender address is blocked.

name: mail.account-metadata
description: Read bounded mailbox metadata and safe settings, excluding account tokens and responder content.

evidence.snippet: account normalization includes accountToken, so projection must exclude it

name: mail.verified-auto-transfer-emails
description: List addresses already verified for mail auto-transfer for one mailbox.

name: mail.global-forwarding
description: Read whole-mailbox forwarding rules and their auto-transfer verification state.

name: mail.draft-item
description: Read bounded metadata for a native draft tied to a thread and message, without returning its body, recipients, images, or attachments.

evidence.snippet: lS draft mapper reads id, threadId, subject, timestamps, images, attachments, and bodyHtml

name: mail.forward-card-messages
description: Read the messages of a Lark Mail forward card from the desktop client's local cache: sender, recipients, subject, summary, optional HTML body, and attachment metadata. Attachment file tokens are never returned. If notInDatabase is true, use mail.forward-card-messages-net.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Forward-card ID from the mail card link (cardId query parameter).

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Card owner's native user ID from the card link (ownerId query parameter).

parameters.name: cardSenderUserId
parameters.description: Optional native user ID of the person who shared the card.

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: Also return each message's HTML body (capped at 200,000 characters per message).

evidence.snippet: gC maps messageItems[].message through p(); attachments map N: fileName, fileSize, fileToken, type, expireTime, fileUrl

name: mail.forward-card-messages-net
description: Read the messages of a Lark Mail forward card from the server (use when the local-cache read reports notInDatabase). Same projection as mail.forward-card-messages; attachment file tokens are never returned.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Forward-card ID from the mail card link (cardId query parameter).

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Card owner's native user ID from the card link (ownerId query parameter).

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: Also return each message's HTML body (capped at 200,000 characters per message).

evidence.snippet: A=(0,d.Vy)(r.tYY,{reqOptions:{transform:(e,t)=>({...e,...t}),logFormat:{cardId,ownerUserId,msgNeedClipped}},resOptions:{transform:(e,t)=>({isFromDb:!1,messageList:gC(e,t[0].threadId)})}}); v() falls back to A when the DB read reports notInDatabase
